additional_info.subject: ID0442409-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / S4 170003481] DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 CRM:02889000385
additional_info.body:
Hi Mert, good morning :)
I checked via SSH the temperature sensor and there is something wrong:
It looks like the sensors are not good. Please measure on site, if the resistance is not reading approximately 1kOhm, then the cable is faulty and needs replacement.
If the reading is 1kOhm then please check where the signal gets lost until the StateMonitor. If you read 1kOhm until the StateMonitor, try replacing the grey connector, you have spare grey connectors on the EcoGs that are not used at all.
If the grey connector still doesn't work please replace the StateMonitor.
I recommend you to take a spare KF13 and CCS cable.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
